components.text: The Painter API writes a pen's PaintPattern to the surface. Gyromancy then uses effect layers to decide which pixels enter recognition. A pixel that looks correct is not

pages.text:
• Hold the pen in the main hand, hold use, and hit the canvas surface.
• PenItem gates repeated samples by distance; StampItem uses its own step.

• In the editor, left draws and right erases; Shift pans or zooms the view.
• Undo, redo, and clear change edit history; the complete snapshot is submitted at the end.
